class.name: HTMLMouseEvent
class.description: Carries the pointer position in the host [HTMLLabel]'s local coordinates, modifier state, and [member related_target] during pointer transitions. For clicks on the same target, [member detail] continues when clicks are less than 500 milliseconds apart and less than 5 pixels apart. The second click dispatches [code]dblclick[/code] after the [code]click[/code] default action.

members.member: The other event target involved in an over, out, enter, or leave transition, or [code]null[/code].
The mouse button that produced the event, using the [enum MouseButton] values.
The bit mask of buttons held when the event was produced.

The consecutive click count for [code]mousedown[/code], [code]mouseup[/code], [code]pointerdown[/code], [code]pointerup[/code], [code]click[/code], and [code]dblclick[/code]. Other event types report [code]0[/code]. A new sequence starts when the target changes, clicks are at least 500 milliseconds apart, or the pointer moves at least 5 pixels.
The pointer position in the host control's local coordinates.
